run_agent_cli: run the agent CLI with an optional agent path to start an interactive AI agent loop
run_agent_with_config: run the agent with a local agent.json config file or a built-in agent from the tiny-agents dataset
run_agent_with_inputs: run the agent and prompt the user for required input values with env variable fallback
run_agent_with_servers: run the agent with stdio and http/sse MCP servers injecting resolved inputs into env and headers
run_cli_with_path: run the CLI subcommand with a path argument pointing to an agent configuration folder
